About this Event

Rituals for Returning: An Evening of Yoga and JournalingJoin us for Rituals for Returning, an intimate evening of gentle yoga and reflective journaling designed to help you slow down, reconnect, and come home to yourself. We’ll gather on Monday, October 12, from 7:30–9:00 PM for a nourishing practice in a welcoming space. This event is by donation; please bring your own mat, RSVP in advance, and note that spots are limited.
